Hi Elena,

Congratulations again — we're excited to move forward. Attached is the preliminary offer letter for the Senior Systems Engineer role. We'd like to hop on a 20-minute call to walk through compensation, answer any questions, and confirm a start date.

Proposed times (PST):
- Mon 2/23 10:00–10:20 AM
- Mon 2/23 3:00–3:20 PM
- Tue 2/24 9:30–9:50 AM

If none of those work, share two windows that do and we'll accommodate. Also attached is the base offer (PDF) — the only items typically discussed on the call are start date, equity vesting cadence, and any questions you/your counsel may have.

Attachments: 20260222_SeniorSystems_Offer_v1.pdf

Thanks — I can send a DocuSign envelope after we confirm.

Best,

If possible I'd like a start date of 3/16/2026 (instead of 3/2) to close out a commitment at my current employer. Otherwise I can be flexible pending your team's needs.

Questions for routing:
- Lauren: can HR accept a 3/16 start and add the recommended flexibility language?
- Neha: hiring manager — okay to push to 3/16 (no impact to ramp)?

1) Start date: confirmed for 2026-03-16 (your request accepted).
2) Offers: legal accepted the limited start-date clause; no changes to equity vesting or termination terms.
3) DocuSign: I've generated the final envelope with the accepted start-date language. Please review and sign here: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/XYZ-123-redwood-morris

Attachments: 20260224_SeniorSystems_Offer_Final.pdf

If you sign by EOD Thursday 2/26, payroll and onboarding will start the required paperwork so your orientation can run on week one of 3/16. Let me know if you need the offer in Word or want a redline comparison.

Thanks — excited to have you join.
